text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: auth anomaly — staging auth service 401/403 spike from multiple unknown IPs. ~1.2k reqs/min. Possible credential scraping. Creating incident INC-3247. Root TS=6245009999

amber-oncall: Ack, I'm on it. Is this only staging?

mike-sre: Looks staging-first. I'm pulling the auth logs now (staging-auth-prod-2026-03-17). Quick grep shows repeated bearer tokens and user-agents like "curl/7.x"

oliver-eng: Can we get a sample IP list? I'll push an edge denylist while we investigate.

mike-sre: Sample IPs: 45.33.12.8, 203.0.113.77, 198.51.100.9 — all hitting /v1/token/exchange and /v1/embed endpoints.

chloe-sec: If logs contain user identifiers, treat as potential PII exposure. Stop any external log drains from staging immediately and snapshot the bucket. Legal loop in if data shows customer identifiers.

amber-oncall: Doing stop now: `kubectl annotate deployment log-forwarder staging disable=true` and pausing the S3 logpush.

mike-sre: Done: suspended log-forwarder, paused fluentd config. Created staging logs snapshot: `s3://redwood-staging-logs/quarantine/INC-3247-snapshot-6245010000`

customer-ops: Any customer impact observed? We have two internal tickets referencing odd 401s but no confirmed data leak reported by customers. Starting watchlist for affected customer IDs.

chloe-sec: Initiate immediate credential rotation for any staging service tokens that could be compromised. Follow the rotation playbook snippet: 
```
# rotation steps (short):
1. identify svcacct tokens with recent activity (query auth-db)
2. create replacement tokens with short TTL
3. deploy new tokens to staging only, verify traffic
4. revoke old tokens after verification
```

amber-oncall: I'll start step 1 now and hand off rotation execution to security for step 2/3. Tagging @chloe-sec to pick up.

oliver-eng: Edge denylist pushed (WAF rule ID wf-7893). Also added a temporary per-IP rate limit of 50r/min for staging endpoints to reduce scraping impact.

mike-sre: Also quarantined staging S3 bucket by changing bucket policy and enabling MFA delete on quarantine prefix. Snapshot stored and ACLs restricted.

chloe-sec: I'll run rotation for the three affected svcaccts and rotate keys via KMS. ETA 20m. Will post verification steps when done.

legal-ops: Please record all actions and retain full snapshots. We need retention for potential review. Do not send customer notices until we have scope.

customer-ops: Understood. Preparing an internal customer impact doc (CID) in #customer-briefs. If we confirm customer identifiers in snapshot we'll prepare a preliminary private notice.

mike-sre: Quick grep of snapshot shows two unique user_ids in raw logs: uid_42 and uid_77 — both look like staging test accounts, no production customer IDs detected in first pass.

chloe-sec: Rotation complete for svcacct-app-staging, svcacct-logbot, svcacct-ci-runner. Verified new tokens accepted and old ones revoked. Running smoke tests.

amber-oncall: Smoke tests green. Edge denylist and rate limits remain. Incident severity -> P2 for now, no confirmed customer PII exposure.

incident-bot: INC-3247 updated: status=mitigating, severity=P2, assignees=[amber-oncall, chloe-sec, mike-sre], pager escalation scheduled 6245020000.

legal-ops: Please attach the S3 snapshot manifest and rotation logs to the incident. We'll review before any external communication.

customer-ops: Notifying 2 affected internal teams to standby. No customer-facing message yet.

amber-oncall: Handoff: I'm off shift in 30m — leaving chloe-sec as owning lead for next actions (forensic hash verification, post-rotate audit). Key next steps in INC-3247: finalize forensic scope, confirm no prod exposure, update CID.

chloe-sec: Got it. I'll take post-rotate audit and coordinate with legal. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
